what: One look for each case and each wording, with the one sentence as the only statement.

wordings.before: The handle of this version is made by the same operations as the version before it, and no filter, group or metric is gone or new.
wordings.after: The handle of this version is made by the same operations as the version before it: the same filters, the same groups and the same metrics. Only the name of a column can differ.

cases.case: a replacement changes only the name of a column
a replacement changes the names of two columns
